verdict.rationale: Any web service with public documentation could publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this question applies to INPI Guichet unique. The evidence pack has no llms.txt, no agent-oriented docs, and no machine-readable documentation for the portal. The probes cover other state hosts (the Annuaire robots.txt and the recherche-entreprises API), not Guichet unique agent docs, so they earn no credit here.
